question:
Choose the correct spelling to complete the sentence:

"Her advice proved to be truly _______ to the success of the project."
solution:
The correct answer is '**indispensable**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**indispensable**" is spelled correctly and refers to something absolutely necessary or essential.
 
• The other options (1, 2, and 3) are incorrect spellings of the word "**indispensable**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Her advice proved to be truly **indispensable**__ to the success of the project."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "indispensible"** is incorrect because the correct spelling is "indispensable" with an "a" instead of "i" in the second part.
 
• **Option 2: "indespensable"** is incorrect because it contains a spelling error; "e" is used instead of "i" in the first part.
 
• **Option 3: "indespensible"** is incorrect because it contains two spelling errors: "e" is used instead of "i" in the first part, and "i" is used instead of "a" in the second part.
